Z2_validation.source: dual of the 3D Ising model, K_c = 0.22165463, tanh K_c = exp(-2 kappa_c)
Z2_validation.duality_note: u_c = 0.330 (3D Ising nearest-neighbour correlation at K_c, literature value); <U_p> = tanh k + (1 - u) / sinh 2k (EXACT given the duality)

Z3_transition.source: dual of the 3D three-state Potts model (first order), K_c(Potts, delta coupling) = 0.550565 (literature); Kramers-Wannier (e^K - 1)(e^K* - 1) = 3; Re W in {1, -1/2} so K* = 3 kappa / 2
